name: Foozun Life RP
detailed_description:
"Foozun Life RP" offers a unique sandbox world where players determine the events. Starting with nothing, you can fight your way through various jobs and build a fortune. Create your own existence, establish businesses, and influence life on the island. Every decision and action shapes the community, offering countless opportunities for roleplay.

Key Features:

  • Dynamic Economy: From simple jobs to owning businesses – the economy is player-driven.
  • Diverse Professions: Work in public service, take on small jobs, or become a successful entrepreneur.
  • Impactful Decisions: Your actions affect the entire island community. Open car dealerships, gas stations, furniture stores, and more.
  • Deep Interactions: Experience a world where relationships between players have real consequences.
  • Rich Environment: Enjoy a detailed world waiting to be discovered and shaped by you.

Why Our Game?

My journey in roleplay began in the early days with military simulations and eventually led me to the latest variants set in an American metropolis. Throughout this time, I encountered many well-designed but never fully perfect games that never quite focused entirely on roleplay. From this experience, we developed this game with the vision of creating a vibrant, player-driven world. Our mechanics are designed to facilitate deep roleplaying situations. It's important to us to create a wide variety of items, offering numerous opportunities for RP and enabling players to take on diverse roles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Dual-Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 9800 GT 1GB / AMD HD 4870 1GB (DX 10, 10.1, 11)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% kompatibel mit DirectX 10
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3470 @ 3.2GHZ (4 CPUs) / AMD X8 FX-8350 @ 4GHZ (8 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 2GB / AMD HD7870 2GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% kompatibel mit DirectX 10
